stories.title: 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games End after 16-Day Run; S. Korea Ranks Third in Medal Tally

en.title: 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games End after 16-Day Run; S. Korea Ranks Third in Medal Tally
en.summary: The 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games concluded after 16 days of competition with a closing ceremony at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium. South Korea finished third in the overall medal standings at the quadrennial event hosted in Japan.

stories.title: S. Korea beat Japan for 4th straight men's football gold

en.title: S. Korea beat Japan for 4th straight men's football gold
en.summary: South Korea defeated Japan 1-0 in the men's football final, securing their fourth consecutive Asian Games gold medal in the sport. The goal came from Eom Ji-sung in the 61st minute at Toyota Stadium.

stories.title: S. Korea adds 6 gold medals as men's football team captures 4th straight title

en.title: S. Korea adds 6 gold medals as men's football team captures 4th straight title
en.summary: South Korea won six gold medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, with the men's football team securing their fourth consecutive title. The country is expected to finish with 39 gold medals, ranking third behind China and Japan.
